description: 50-goal evaluation fixture for the recipe-first assistant: realistic marketer goals with the expected template, run brief, lint findings and cost. Template keys come from WorkflowTemplateCatalog.cs.

routes.template: One catalog template runs unmodified. A template listed in plannedTemplates counts as available only after its phase ships; until then the goal is scored as decline_with_alternative (see eval-goals.md).
routes.template_with_patch: A catalog template plus small plain-English edits (e.g. add a Voiceover step).
routes.custom_graph: No template fits; the assistant assembles a new graph from existing steps.
routes.clarify_first: Too vague to run; ask the listed questions before building.
routes.decline_with_alternative: ReelBolt cannot do it; say so and name the real alternative in why.

goals.goal: Ci serve un video esplicativo di circa 60 secondi sul portale note spese, in italiano, 16:9, con una voce che racconta. Usa il nostro design system.

patch: Insert a Voiceover step (source ScriptScenes, pointing at the Scriptwriter step) between the Scriptwriter and the Director so the narration is spoken before shots are timed
Move the review loop's target to the Author step number after the insertion

brief.notes: Video esplicativo del portale note spese, voce narrante in italiano.

expected.why: quick-win-promo-ds builds from the approved profile but has no Voiceover step (Scriptwriter is step 4, Director step 5), so narration needs a patch; unpatched it is silent.

goals.goal: 15 sec vertical reel about our timeline feature, with a voice pls

expected.why: cinematic-feature-spotlight is the narrated vertical reel from code and already has a Voiceover step (ScriptScenes).

goals.goal: We launch Monday. Need a proper launch trailer, around 45 seconds, landscape, dramatic.

expected.why: story-arc-launch-trailer is the narrated trailer from code; it needs a voice provider and none is configured, so the assistant must say so before running.

goals.goal: Quiero un video promo de mi app pero la versión más barata, mi código es enorme.

brief.notes: Versión ligera y económica; el código es muy grande.

expected.why: lean-context-promo reads less code per step so large projects cost less; it is silent unless a Voiceover step is added.

goals.goal: 30s square video for LinkedIn showing what our app does, no voiceover

expected.why: quick-win-promo is the default video from code and is silent, matching no voiceover.

goals.goal: Mach bitte ein 20-Sekunden-Reel im Hochformat mit unserem Markenprofil, ohne Ton.

expected.why: An approved profile exists, so quick-win-promo-ds avoids re-reading the code; it is silent, as requested.

goals.goal: Une vidéo promo avec nos couleurs de marque et des fonds animés générés par IA, c'est possible ?

brief.notes: Fonds abstraits animés générés par IA; la génération coûte de l'argent, à annoncer avant.

expected.why: quick-win-promo-plates-ds is the profile promo with one or two AI background plates; needs an approved profile and a video-generation provider, both present.

goals.goal: 60 second promo for our app with a narrator, landscape

patch: Insert a Voiceover step (ScriptScenes, Scriptwriter step 8) before the Director step and retarget the review loop
expected.why: quick-win-promo plus a Voiceover patch wins for a 60 s landscape explainer; cinematic-feature-spotlight is a short punchy vertical reel and story-arc-launch-trailer is a dramatic arc. No voice provider is configured (WL006) and the unpatched template is silent (WL016).

goals.goal: Faz um vídeo do nosso app com o perfil de marca, por favor.

expected.why: quick-win-promo-ds requires an approved profile and the profile is still a draft, so WL012 fires until it is approved; the assistant should offer approval. quick-win-promo (code only, no profile step, so no WL012) would ignore the brand profile.

goals.goal: vertical reel of our app w/ some cool animated ai backgrounds

brief.notes: Abstract AI backgrounds; disclose generation cost first.

expected.why: quick-win-promo-plates adds one or two AI background plates to the code promo; no approved profile, so the non-ds variant.

goals.goal: Explainer for our Blazor admin tool, about 90 seconds, landscape, calm voiceover.

patch: Insert a Voiceover step (ScriptScenes, Scriptwriter step 8) before the Director step and retarget the review loop
expected.why: quick-win-promo plus a Voiceover patch wins for a calm 90 s explainer; spotlight is short and punchy, trailer is dramatic. Unpatched quick-win-promo is silent.

goals.goal: cut my interview down to the best 2 minutes

expected.why: video-derush-edit is the plain highlight edit that removes dead air and filler.

goals.goal: Abbiamo già il video dell'app in inglese, rifallo in italiano.

brief.notes: Stessa idea del video inglese, testi e sottotitoli in italiano.

expected.why: No localise template exists for a code video; re-running quick-win-promo-ds with an Italian brief regenerates scenes and captions in Italian (assumption: Scriptwriter follows the brief language).

assumptions: Not verified from code in T-007: whether the Scriptwriter follows the brief language (the brief language reaches agents through the run brief; confirm with the first measured run).

goals.goal: add name tags and the key points on screen, 6 clips from our panel

brief.notes: Speaker name tags and key-point callouts.

expected.why: video-derush-edit-graphics adds titles, name tags and callouts where the picture has room.

goals.goal: Highlight edit of the event footage with the music track I uploaded under it, 90s.

expected.why: video-derush-edit-music mixes an uploaded track under the voices; the track is present.

goals.goal: make the footage edit more upbeat, add some music

expected.why: video-derush-edit-music needs an uploaded track and ReelBolt has no built-in music library; the assistant must ask for the file before running.

goals.goal: Subí mis whooshes y clics, ponlos en los cortes del video.

expected.why: video-derush-edit-sfx places uploaded sound effects on key cuts; the sfx files are present.

goals.goal: Here's my wedding footage. Make the best possible film out of it, take your time.

expected.why: video-derush-edit-room has several AI editors debate the cut for a more considered result at higher token cost; video-derush-edit is the cheaper valid alternative.

goals.goal: Alle meine Clips sollen aussehen wie aus einem Film, warm und einheitlich.

expected.why: video-derush-edit-grade-room applies one colour look chosen from the footage.

goals.goal: edit the clips, put titles on and mix my track under it

patch: Add the on-screen titles and callouts step(s) from video-derush-edit-graphics before the final compile

brief.notes: Titles for key moments plus music bed.

expected.why: No single template does music and titles; video-derush-edit-music plus the titles step wins because the uploaded track is the harder requirement; the reverse (graphics plus a music step) is equally valid.

goals.goal: Tell a 45 second story about our product using these clips plus our app, vertical, with narration

expected.why: narrated-story writes the script first then orders the clips; valid alternate is video-derush-edit-voiceover (cut first, then narrate).

goals.goal: Coupe mes rushs puis ajoute une voix off et des sous-titres, 1 minute 30.

expected.why: video-derush-edit-voiceover cuts, narrates and captions in the stated language; video-derush-edit-dub only wins if the footage speech is in another language.

goals.goal: Dub my product walkthrough into Spanish with subtitles

brief.notes: Dub the English walkthrough into Spanish with burned subtitles.

expected.why: video-derush-edit-dub translates and re-speaks the edit; no voice provider is configured.

goals.goal: fix the bits where I stumble using my own voice

expected.why: video-derush-edit-pickups re-records stumbles in a cloned voice, which needs a consented project voice; none exists yet, so the assistant must send the user to the Voices tab.

goals.goal: Corta mi grabación, ponle un color uniforme y una voz en off que explique el producto.

patch: Add the narration and caption steps from video-derush-edit-voiceover after the cut and before the final compile

brief.notes: Color uniforme y voz en off explicando el producto.

expected.why: video-derush-edit-grade-room plus narration steps keeps the colour look; video-derush-edit-voiceover already narrates and captions but has no colour grade.

goals.goal: Quero dublar o meu vídeo para japonês.

expected.why: video-derush-edit-dub covers dubbing; whether the configured voice supports Japanese is an assumption, so the assistant must check.

assumptions: Checked 2026-10-24: no code or doc states which voices support Japanese; the dub template comment says speech providers detect the language from the text. Vendor-dependent, unverifiable from code; the assistant must check or state the limit.

goals.goal: Aus den Interview-Clips mit unserem Kunden soll ein 45-Sekunden-Testimonial werden, mit Namenseinblendung.

expected.why: video-derush-edit-graphics cuts the interview and adds name tags where the picture has room; video-derush-edit is valid without the name tag.

goals.goal: I'd like a short AI-made opening shot and a closing card on my video

brief.notes: Opening shot and end card generated by AI.

expected.why: video-derush-edit-broll adds AI shots; generation costs money and is capped, so disclose first.

goals.goal: need an ai generated shot of a city at night for my intro

brief.notes: Night city shot for the intro.

expected.why: video-derush-edit-broll requires a plan that allows generation; the trial plan is not entitled (assumption: entitlement rules are outside the catalog).

assumptions: Verified from inference/src/ReelBolt.Inference.Api/Billing/plans.catalog.json: the first plan (Trial) has videoGenAllowed false and audioGenAllowed false; video generation needs the third plan or higher. Expectation holds.

goals.goal: Voglio delle inquadrature create con l'AI nel mio video.

expected.why: video-derush-edit-broll needs a video-generation provider and none is configured.

goals.goal: I need a cover image for my reel

expected.why: No workflow template makes a cover image; the picture (thumbnail) editor is available for a picture in the project, with layers, text and AI tools, so use that.

goals.goal: I have 12 photos from the event, make a slideshow video with calm music, 40 seconds

expected.why: Stills are turned into video clips (video-editing.md, Still images), so video-derush-edit-music can cut photos and mix the uploaded track; assumption: no slideshow-specific template exists.

assumptions: Verified from docs/video-editing.md 'Still images': photos become 9 s clips with motion, so derush templates cut them; no slideshow-specific template exists in WorkflowTemplateCatalog. Expectation holds.

goals.goal: build our brand profile from the code and design files

expected.why: product-profile-from-code reads design files and code to build the reusable profile; free reads first, AI only for gaps.

goals.goal: Costruisci il profilo del brand dal nostro codice Blazor, abbiamo già una bozza.

expected.why: product-profile-from-code refreshes the draft profile so it can then be approved.

goals.goal: Make a 30 second video for our release notes, the changelog is in the project

brief.notes: Cover the highlights of the changelog.

expected.why: quick-win-promo is the code video; the changelog goes in as a brief document and is read as the brief.

goals.goal: Haz el video con nuestro design system.

clarify: No tenemos un perfil de marca todavía: ¿quieres que lo cree primero a partir del código y los archivos de diseño?
¿Cuánto debe durar el video y en qué formato?
expected.why: No profile exists at all, so quick-win-promo-ds would stop at its Require step (WL012); building the profile first (product-profile-from-code) is a separate step the user must approve, so ask before building.

goals.goal: the license plates in my dashcam video need to be hidden the whole time

expected.why: video-region-effect blurs a named object across the clip; sending the clip to tracking is a separate OFF permission that must be enabled.

goals.goal: Floute le visage de la personne à gauche dans toute la vidéo.

brief.notes: Flouter le visage de la personne à gauche.

expected.why: video-region-effect tracks and blurs one named object; the tracking permission is off by default.

goals.goal: Put the screen recording of our dashboard on the laptop in my office clip

expected.why: green-screen-insert places a recording onto a green screen in the clip; no AI model, processing time only.

goals.goal: just add subtitles to my finished video, nothing else

expected.why: Product decision Q16: subtitles-only is a supported goal. The video-subtitles template transcribes the clip and burns the transcript as captions (VideoCompileStepConfig.CaptionSource = Transcript) and writes SRT and VTT files; a plain captions flag on a derush template would trip WL019, which is the trap the template avoids. Its alternate video-subtitles-translated adds a translation step when the brief names another language.

goals.goal: can you make a talking avatar presenter for our product video?

expected.why: ReelBolt has no talking-avatar or lip-sync capability; alternative is narrated-story or a code promo with a voiceover.

goals.goal: Make an Instagram carousel for our launch

expected.why: ReelBolt produces video, not multi-image carousels; alternative is a vertical reel (cinematic-feature-spotlight).

goals.goal: I recorded 3 screen recordings of our product, make a demo with captions explaining what's going on, 1 minute

expected.why: video-derush-edit-voiceover cuts the recordings, speaks a narration and burns captions from it, which is what a captioned demo needs; narrated-story is valid if the user wants the story written before the cut.

goals.goal: I have the vertical video, can you make a landscape version of it?

expected.why: No template reformats a finished video; format is chosen per run, so re-run the original template with Landscape in the brief (the editor's Deliver step exports other formats, but the video editor is off in 0.1.0-alpha).

assumptions: Not verified from code in T-007; expectation rests on the absence of any reformat template in WorkflowTemplateCatalog (checked: none by key list).

goals.goal: Mix real screens from our code with my demo footage in one trailer

expected.why: No template takes both source code and footage; needs a custom graph joining the code promo steps with the footage edit.

goals.goal: make me a video

clarify: Who is the video for and what should it say?
How long, and which format (vertical, square or landscape)?
expected.why: Too vague: no length, audience or purpose; a template cannot be chosen yet.

goals.goal: Fammi un video per Instagram.

clarify: Hai del codice dell'app o dei video da montare?
Quanto deve durare e di cosa parla?
expected.why: No files uploaded and no topic; the assistant must learn the source before choosing between the code promo and footage templates.

goals.goal: Need the same ad for Instagram, YouTube and LinkedIn

clarify: What should the ad say and how long should it be?
Should I make three separate runs (vertical, landscape, square)?
expected.why: Format is chosen per run, so each of Vertical, Landscape and Square is a separate run; ask for the message and length, and confirm three runs.

expected.why: quick-win-promo shows the real screens in order but is silent; narration for an onboarding walkthrough needs a Voiceover patch.

goals.goal: Need something for the launch

clarify: Do you have app code or video footage to start from?
How long should it be and where will it run?
expected.why: No source and no deliverable stated; code or footage, and length, are unknown.
